Main field:  Electronic Design

Mandatory for: MSOC2
Elective for: D5, E4-is, N4
Language of instruction: The course will be given in English

The aim is to provide knowledge about practical verification of integrated circuits, with an emphasis on system-on-chip. The circuits to verify are designed by the students in the course IC-project, and can be either analog, digital, computer oriented, or mixed mode, and the design work can be performed on either transistor or block level.

Knowledge and understanding
      For a passing grade the student must

Competences and skills
      For a passing grade the student must

Judgement and approach
      For a passing grade the student must

The course provides the students an opportunity to verify a complete chip from the course IC-project. The verification is performed by measurements, and it is important to measure several different properties of the circuits and understand the reason for differences between simulated and measured behavior. If the design of the student has been selected for fabrication he/she will verify his own circuit. Otherwise an already existing circuit can be verified. In special cases digital designs can be implemented and verified using FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) or EDA tools. The requirements on design complexity and volume of the report will in those cases be increased. The result of the verification is presented in a report, which is also presented orally.

Grading scale: TH - (U, 3, 4, 5) - (Fail, Three, Four, Five)
Assessment: Verification of integrated Circuits, designed by the students in the course IC-Project 1.The grade is based on the quality of the work as well as the report and oral presentation of the work. The work is performed in groups and an assessment is made of the efforts of the group as well as the individual participants. If the work is not finished within the given time frame, a higher grade than 3 can not be given.

The examiner, in consultation with Disability Support Services, may deviate from the regular form of examination in order to provide a permanently disabled student with a form of examination equivalent to that of a student without a disability.

Modules
Code: 0215. Name: Report. 

Credits: 0.0. Grading scale: UG - (U, G).
        
          Assessment: Written report and oral presentation of the work.
        
        
        
        
Code: 0115. Name: Verification. 

Credits: 7.5. Grading scale: TH - (U, 3, 4, 5).
        
          Assessment: Verification of integrated Circuits, designed by the students in the course IC-Project 1.

Course coordinator: Baktash Behmanesh,
        baktash.behmanesh@eit.lth.se
Course coordinator: Joachim Rodrigues (digital och dator),
        joachim.rodrigues@eit.lth.se
Course homepage: https://www.eit.lth.se/course/etin40
To get access to the design tools used in the course, the software and technology providers require students to sign a non-disclosure agreement.
